Imagine a world on the edge of a technological revolution—where every heartbeat carries both anticipation and a trace of danger. Here, the drive for innovation and the ambitions of everyday people are tangled together, invisible but unbreakable. That’s the world Erik Larson sweeps us into with Thunderstruck. Together, we’ll step into a time when wireless communication was about to turn society upside down, and the line between science and daily life started to melt away. Picture Edwardian London: the air thick with invention, the race to master the power of the ether, and a city alive with mystery. As Guglielmo Marconi pushes to perfect wireless telegraphy, his relentless ambition echoes through grand halls and shadowy alleyways alike. But there’s more—because right in the midst of all this progress, a chilling murder mystery unfolds, weaving its way through the heart of the city. What if every new breakthrough brought not just hope, but also risk? In this story, the forces of discovery, suspense, and the quest for understanding are all in play, inviting us to look closer at the people who dared to change history.
So, welcome to this journey. Together, we’ll explore the magic and the mayhem of an era that forever altered the way we connect—with each other, and with the world itself.
